subject: general
question: In which Indian state was a 1,300-year-old stupa discovered by the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) in February 2023?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Odisha**__ [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• In February 2023, the Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) **discovered a 1,300-year-old Buddhist stupa in the Jajpur district of Odisha**.
 
• The stupa was **found in a Khondalite stone mining site.** 
 
• The Khondalite mining site supplies stones for the beautification of the 12th-century Shree Jagannath Temple in Puri. &
